messages:
ashley: FYI dropping the SageHill RFP here. They want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a POC pricing/options breakdown. POC target start: 2026-05-04. Attaching a draft matrix in a sec. @maria can you own the matrix + KMS/HSM blurb?

maria: on it. will upload matrix v1 and KMS section by EOD. quick note — for on-prem HSM we need Private deployment + services. Hosted can do BYOK via cloud KMS but not customer HSM appliances. I'll call that out in the RFP answer.

ashley: perfect. also need a short feature comparison vs their incumbent (latency SLOs, autoscale, per-tenant key separation, streaming & function-calling). Sam, can you draft the pricing delta for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private?

sam: yes. quick numbers for planning: 2-week Dedicated POC (4x A100-equivalent) ~ $30k total (includes infra + engineering support). Hosted pilot (shared) we can do for ~$8k + data transfer. Private on-prem estimated setup 3-4 weeks, services + infra ~ $70k one-time (TBD after infra audit). I'll drop a spreadsheet.

jules: for the feature matrix here's a tiny draft snippet you can paste into the attachment:
```
Feature,Redwood (Hosted),Redwood (Dedicated),Redwood (Private),Incumbent
Latency (p50/p95),30ms / 180ms,20ms / 120ms,20ms / 120ms,200ms / 850ms
Autoscale,yes (auto-burst),yes (configurable),manual (ops),limited
Per-tenant keys,BYOK (KMS),BYOK + isolation,HW HSM per-customer,shared keys
Streaming & tools,streaming + function-calls,streaming + function-calls,streaming (local),limited
```

ana (security): For RFP security answers: we can provide SOC2 type II, pen-test summary, and encryption in transit & at rest. For HSM statements: we integrate with PKCS#11-compatible appliances for Private deployments. We cannot assert FIPS certification for a customer-provided appliance — we'll need their certs. I'll attach the security questionnaire responses.

ashley: noted. @kent customer asked specifically about EU-only data residency + 3yr retention. Can we commit to that in Hosted?

kent: SageHill insists on EU residency + 3yr retention. We can host in EU regions and offer retention controls, but 3yr retention with legal guarantees needs contract wording (SOW + data addendum). I pushed asking if 1yr is acceptable but they said mandatory 3yr.

sam: ops blocker: they also require per-tenant HSM-backed key separation for certain workloads. Hosted BYOK via KMS doesn't give per-tenant HSM appliances isolation. Our recommendation: Dedicated with tenant isolation or Private on-prem for strict HSM separation. I'll add that to the RFP matrix.

maria: uploaded files: sagehill-capability-matrix-v1.xlsx, sagehill-rfp-answers-draft.pdf to the thread (links attached). Marked items that need legal/security review with TODO flags.

devops-bot: Deployment job #2981 finished: uploaded sagehill-capability-matrix-v1.xlsx -> sales-drive/sagehill/.

ashley: action items summary: (1) Maria finalize matrix + KMS/HSM wording (EOD), (2) Sam finalize pricing spreadsheet + POC SOW draft (tomorrow), (3) Ana finalize security questionnaire attachments (EOD), (4) I'll prepare POC schedule and send to the customer. Proposed POC kickoff 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-18. Any immediate blockers?

ana (security): need confirmation whether their network requires air-gapped or appliance-only connectivity. If air-gapped, timeline and approach change significantly.

ashley: I'll ask product contact in the bid to confirm air-gap requirement. Thanks everyone, will update after their reply. :thumbsup:
